game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Ore Vein Depths, a rich ore vein: the cave miner must handle shadow wraiths while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Guess Until Right: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints.
theme: Shadow Cave – Ore Vein Depths: a rich ore vein
